total_definition: Total = Prompt + ToolUsePrompt + Thinking + Candidates; cached prompt is already included in Prompt.
required: Prompt, Candidates, Total must be explicit nonnegative integers, not bool. Normalized P/C/Total must match the untouched SDK snapshot.
optional: Thinking and ToolUsePrompt may be absent/null; their raw values remain unchanged. Invalid present values stop.
allocation: Residual = Total - Prompt - Candidates. Subtract reported optional components. One missing component is DERIVED; two missing with zero residual are DERIVED zero; two missing with positive residual each have BOUNDED [0,residual] and joint sum=residual. Contradictions are UNKNOWN.
caps: Worst-case Prompt+ToolUsePrompt <= input_token_cap; Candidates+Thinking <= max_output_tokens and billable_output_token_cap. Bounds do not change any cap.
cost: Decimal arithmetic: exact reported/derived input/output components plus unallocated joint residual at max(input_rate,output_rate), counted once. Must fit the same reservation; no refunds.
verdict: safe/reason are separate from provenance. LiveTransport and VERIFY recompute the same accounting object. UNKNOWN or unsafe stops.
history: No retroactive changes to v1/v2 campaigns. A v3 send is a new request and needs separate human authorization.
